page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head above the text: none. Marginal references in the right margin, beside the line "illos honoraturum, qui DEVM" and the line after it. Gathering signature at the foot, left of centre. Catchword "nore" at the lower right.

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: sanctè colere didicerunt. Sumptus nonnulli faciendi erunt, quibus nequaquam parcendum esse, lucrum quod ex illorum commercio capitur, majusque & securius plantato inter ipsos Evangelio expectatur, facilè persuadebit. Nolo jam accuratè inquirere, cur mercaturæ expediat ad puram religionem infideles Orientis populos adduci; non dicam quàm firmum adversus Lusitanos præsidium, incolarum futura sit benevolentia; quàm inviolabilis consociatio, quæ Religionis vinculo constringetur: unum hoc cum DEI verbo profitebor, DEVM 1.Sam.2. 30.illos honoraturum, qui DEVM suum honoraverint: quo ho-

page.notes: The head "DEDICATIO." is set in spaced capitals and is treated as the title of the dedication. The text runs on from the previous page ("sanctè colere didicerunt."). The right-margin reference is printed as "1.Sam.2." with "30." set on the next line; both are kept in one note. The small-capital words "DEI", "DEVM" are given in capitals. The foot mark "* 5" is partly unclear, so I marked it [?]. The line-end "ho-" is a printed hyphen, and the catchword "nore" completes it on the next page. No page number is printed.
